name: gcp-alerting-evidence
description: Reads one Google Cloud project's notification channels and selected alert policies for security-alerting-check, handing on email addresses only as fingerprints. GET only, bounded.

AUTH_HEADER.description: 'Bearer ' and a vault reference to an impersonated read-only service account's token: 'Bearer vault://gcp/impersonated/<reader-sa>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com/access_token'. The controller mints it at dispatch. Grant the installed copy that one path.

PROJECT.description: The Google Cloud project to read, by id.

SECURITY_GROUP_EMAIL.description: The security group's email address. It is handed on only as a SHA-256 fingerprint of the trimmed, lower-cased address, never in plain.

ALERT_POLICY_SELECTOR.description: Which alerting policies are the security alerts: {"label": "<key>=<value>"} or {"display_name_prefix": "<prefix>"}, one form only. Absent or malformed, the policies are left unread (and the check's alert rules not assessed); the channels are still read.

setup_instructions.title: Create a read-only reader account
setup_instructions.detail: In the project, a service account the controller may impersonate, holding only: monitoring.notificationChannels.list and monitoring.alertPolicies.list (both in roles/monitoring.viewer).

setup_instructions.title: Connect Google Cloud
setup_instructions.detail: Complete the Google Cloud (full) connection, so the controller can mint the impersonated token at dispatch.

setup_instructions.title: Configure and grant
setup_instructions.detail: Set AUTH_HEADER and PROJECT on the node, and grant the installed copy the one gcp/impersonated/<reader-sa>/access_token path.
